Terms and Conditions

Last updated: October 30, 2026

These Terms and Conditions govern your access to and use of ASND, including its website, applications, profiles, discovery tools, opportunities, messaging, and related services.
ASND is currently an unincorporated project operated by Aryan Irani.
In these Terms, "ASND," "we," "us," and "our" refer to the ASND service as currently operated by Aryan Irani.
By creating an account, joining a waitlist, applying for access, or using ASND, you agree to these Terms.
If you do not agree, do not use ASND.

1. What ASND is

ASND is a vetted network designed to help creators, brands, and agencies discover and connect with relevant creative collaborators.
ASND may provide tools for creating professional profiles; discovering creators, brands, and agencies; posting and responding to opportunities; connecting with relevant collaborators; and communicating after a connection is made.
ASND is a discovery and connection service.
Agencies on ASND are participants. An agency may have its own profile, find collaborators for its own work, and be found by other users. Agencies do not act as intermediaries and do not broker connections between other users through ASND. Unless expressly stated otherwise, ASND does not act as an employer, staffing agency, talent agency, representative, broker, payment provider, or party to agreements entered into between users.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or use ASND.
By using ASND, you confirm that you are legally able to enter into these Terms, the information you provide is accurate, and you are not prohibited from using the service under applicable law.
If you use ASND on behalf of a business, agency, or organization, you confirm that you have authority to act on its behalf.

3. User types

ASND currently supports three primary account types:

Creators
Individuals offering creative skills, services, or work.
Brands
Businesses or organizations seeking creative collaborators.
Agencies
Businesses or organizations offering creative services or representing talent, who use ASND as participants to find collaborators for their own work and to be found by others.
ASND may limit users to one primary role per account.
Agency accounts
Each agency has one agency account. Individual people who work at an agency may hold their own ASND accounts as creators or brand-side users, and may be linked to the agency's profile.
An agency may link its profile to a creator only if that creator holds their own ASND profile and has agreed to the link. An agency profile may not list creators who are not ASND members.

4. Applications and vetting

Certain users, particularly creators and agencies, may be required to complete an application before receiving full access. Creator applications may include identity and contact information, portfolio or website links, social media links, previous clients or collaborations, work samples, and references or people who can vouch for the applicant.
Creator vetting is conducted through human review.
ASND does not represent that artificial intelligence independently evaluates or approves creative work.

Agency verification
Agencies are also reviewed by people before receiving full access. Agency applications may include agency name, website, and work email; portfolio or past work; previous clients or collaborations; the creators and brands the agency works with; and at least one client or creator who can confirm the relationship with the agency.
Agency verification is conducted through human review, and ASND does not represent that artificial intelligence independently approves agencies.
A reference or vouch does not guarantee acceptance.
ASND may accept, hold, request additional information from, or decline to activate an applicant based on the needs and standards of the network.
Admission to ASND does not guarantee work, income, responses, opportunities, or future collaboration.

5. Accounts

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for activity through your account.
You agree to provide accurate information, keep your information reasonably current, maintain control of your login credentials, and notify ASND if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.
You may not sell, transfer, rent, or share your account without permission.

6. Profiles and visible information

Certain profile information may be visible to other ASND users

Depending on your account type, this may include name; profile image; location; discipline; niche or specialty; portfolio; work samples; availability; previous collaborations; brand or client associations; agency affiliation, and links to creators who hold their own ASND profiles; and professional information.
You are responsible for ensuring that you have permission to upload or display any content, images, logos, work samples, or other materials you provide.

7. Opportunities and briefs

Brands, agencies, and eligible creators may be able to post opportunities or briefs.
Agencies post opportunities and briefs for their own work. If an agency posts a brief on behalf of a client, the brief must name the client or clearly state that it is posted on behalf of a client.
Briefs may include deliverables; compensation; deadlines; usage rights; project details; eligibility requirements; confidentiality requirements; and the client on whose behalf the brief is posted, if any.
The person or organization posting the opportunity is responsible for the accuracy and legality of the information provided. ASND does not guarantee that a brief will receive responses, a creator will be selected, a project will proceed, compensation will be paid, deliverables will be accepted, and either party will complete an agreement.
Users are responsible for evaluating opportunities and collaborators before entering into any arrangement.

8. Private opportunities and confidentiality

Some opportunities may be marked private or may require acceptance of confidentiality terms before full details are visible.
If you accept confidentiality obligations, you are responsible for complying with them.
ASND may provide tools that facilitate acceptance of confidentiality terms but is not responsible for enforcing agreements between users unless ASND is expressly a party to that agreement.

9. Connections and messaging

When users connect through ASND, the service may provide a messaging channel.
You may not use messaging to harass or threaten another person, send spam, impersonate another person, distribute malicious software, solicit unlawful activity, share content you do not have permission to distribute, and attempt to bypass platform security.
ASND may investigate reported misuse and restrict access when appropriate.

10. Relationships between users

Users are responsible for their own negotiations and agreements.
This may include compensation, deliverables, deadlines, intellectual property, content usage, licensing, exclusivity, confidentiality, cancellations, revisions, taxes, and expenses.
ASND is not responsible for resolving commercial disputes between users unless we expressly agree otherwise.

Agreements between an agency and its clients, creators, or staff are separate from ASND and are the responsibility of those parties.
ASND does not guarantee the identity, conduct, reliability, financial condition, quality, or legal compliance of any user simply because that user is present on the network.
Vetting is intended to improve trust and relevance, not eliminate risk.

11. No employment relationship

Using ASND does not create an employment relationship between ASND and any creator, brand, agency, or other user. Nothing in these Terms creates a partnership, joint venture, fiduciary relationship, franchise, employment relationship, or agency relationship between ASND and a user.

ASND may introduce paid subscriptions or other paid features.
Any pricing, billing frequency, renewal terms, cancellation rights, and taxes will be disclosed before purchase.

ASND may offer referral programs.

Submitting a name alone does not automatically create a right to payment.

16. Acceptable use

You may not provide deliberately false information; impersonate another person or company; create fraudulent profiles; scrape or systematically extract ASND data; use automated tools to collect member information without permission; interfere with platform security or operation; upload unlawful or infringing content; harass other users; use ASND for fraud or illegal activity; manipulate references, reviews, or vetting; attempt to gain unauthorized access to another account; resell access to ASND data or profiles without permission; link an agency profile to a creator without that creator's agreement; and post a brief on behalf of a client without the disclosure required by these Terms.
ASND may suspend or restrict users who violate these rules.
